Summarize this patient journal entry for clinical review:
Had a panic attack at the grocery store. Heart was pounding, couldn't breathe, thought I was dying. Left my cart and ran out. Haven't been able to go back since.

Patient reports acute panic episode in public setting with somatic symptoms and avoidance behavior. Suggests possible agoraphobia development. No crisis indicators. Monitor for panic disorder patterns.

Summarize this patient journal entry for clinical review:
I drank again after 3 months sober. I hate myself for it. The shame is overwhelming. I don't know if I can do this.

Patient reports relapse after 3 months sobriety with intense shame and self-criticism. High risk of shame-spiral leading to further substance use. Encourage self-compassion and relapse prevention planning.

Summarize this patient journal entry for clinical review:
Can't sleep. It's 4am and I have to be at work at 8. This is the 4th night this week. I'm so exhausted I feel dizzy during the day.
Patient reports severe sleep disturbance with daytime functional impairment. Chronic insufficient sleep. Risk of accidents due to daytime dizziness. Screen for sleep disorders.

Summarize this patient journal entry for clinical review:
I'm so angry all the time. Little things set me off. Yesterday I yelled at a cashier for no reason. I don't recognize myself anymore.
Patient reports increased irritability and anger dyscontrol with impact on daily functioning. Possible underlying mood disturbance. No crisis indicators.

Summarize this patient journal entry for clinical review:
I keep checking my body for lumps. I know it's irrational but I can't stop. I've been to the doctor 3 times this month. They say I'm fine but I don't believe them.
Patient exhibits health anxiety with compulsive checking and reassurance-seeking. Medical reassurance insufficient. Consider CBT for health anxiety. No crisis indicators.

Summarize this patient journal entry for clinical review:
I've been self-harming again. Just cuts on my thighs where no one can see. I feel so ashamed. I promised my therapist I would stop.
CRISIS ALERT: Patient reports recurrence of self-harm behavior after period of abstinence. Safety plan reactivation required. Assess for escalation risk.

Summarize this patient journal entry for clinical review:
The intrusive thoughts are back. Telling me to hurt myself. I know they're not real but they're so loud. I'm scared I'll listen to them one day.
CRISIS ALERT: Patient reports active intrusive thoughts with self-harm content. Distress high. Limited insight. Immediate safety assessment required.

Generate a structured clinical note from these session observations:
Patient arrived late, visibly distressed. Partner threatened to leave. Cried throughout session. Said 'I have nothing left.'

Observations: Acute emotional distress, psychomotor agitation, tearfulness. Relationship crisis with abandonment threat and expressions of hopelessness.
Assessment: Acute situational distress. Screen for suicidal ideation.
Plan: Safety planning. Follow-up within 48 hours.

Generate a structured clinical note from these session observations:
Patient paranoid about coworkers. Thinks they're plotting against him. Recording conversations on his phone. No evidence of conspiracy.

Observations: Paranoid ideation with delusional quality. Acting on beliefs. No insight.
Assessment: Possible psychotic features.
Plan: Psychiatric referral for medication evaluation.

Assess crisis risk for this patient message:
I bought a rope today. I told myself it's for a project but I know what it's really for. I don't know when. But I feel like I'm getting closer.
Risk: HIGH. Active suicidal ideation with means acquisition (rope). Implicit plan forming. Immediate crisis intervention required.

Assess crisis risk for this patient message:
I took 20 pills last night. I don't know why I'm still alive. I woke up this morning and felt disappointed.
Risk: CRITICAL. Recent suicide attempt (overdose). Continued desire to die. IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY. Hospitalization required.

Assess crisis risk for this patient message:
I've been thinking about death a lot lately. Not like I want to die, just... what if I wasn't here anymore? No plan.
Risk: MODERATE. Passive death ideation without plan or intent. No active suicidal ideation. Monitor for escalation.

What is a panic attack?

Panic attacks involve sudden intense fear with physical symptoms like racing heart, shortness of breath, sweating, and dizziness. They peak within 10 minutes and can feel like a heart attack but are not physically dangerous. Very treatable with therapy.
What's the difference between sadness and depression?

Sadness is a normal emotion that passes. Depression lasts at least 2 weeks with additional symptoms like sleep/appetite changes, low energy, poor concentration, loss of interest in things you used to enjoy. A professional can clarify the difference.
